name: welloby anarchy » Java 1.7.2–26.3 + Bedrock
description:
Welloby is a small anarchy-inspired survival server. Build a hidden base, form a group, raid, trade, or explore on your own. PvP, griefing and stealing are part of the game.

Java and Bedrock play together on Paper 1.21.11. Hacked clients are allowed within the server's movement and exploit limits. Lag machines, crash exploits, slurs and advertising other servers are not allowed.

Homes, local teleports and jobs add a few conveniences:

- /tpa works within 1,000 blocks and costs 40 in-game money. Accept with /tpaccept for free.

- /sethome works in the Overworld within 5,000 blocks of spawn; /home costs 25.

- /jobs gives you ways to earn money, and /pay lets players trade.

- /lfg shares your own location after confirmation, so use it carefully.

Keepinventory is off and there is no /back. There are no land claims or starter gear kits. The map opened in September 2026 and is intended to persist. Optional donations support the server; cosmetic supporter packages are still being prepared.

Java: mc.welloby.com

Bedrock: bedrock.welloby.com, port 25620

Discord: https://discord.gg/cwHKDtXQWD

Website: https://welloby.com

Join, find a base spot, and leave your mark on the map.
